fields.name: MapSqlShardKeyAttribute constructor family
fields.contract: MapSqlShardKeyAttribute configures an attributed virtual compound key for SQL mapping. All overloads require recordIdName; overloads may add shardIdName, childIdName, grandChildIdName, greatGrandChildIdName, and isRecordIdentifier. A supplied shardIdName is represented by a SQL SmallInt mapping with isRequired=false. Overloads without isRecordIdentifier set it to true; overloads with it preserve the supplied value. The three-argument (shardIdName, recordIdName, childIdName) overload assigns childIdName to the child, grandchild, and great-grandchild configuration slots; the four- through six-argument forms assign each supplied subordinate name to its corresponding slot.
